name: MathTutorBench
summary: A benchmark that scores AI tutors on seven math tutoring tasks across math expertise, understanding the student and teaching, with a trained reward model for open-ended scaffolding.

license.note: The README's badge says CC BY 4.0; its footer and the project page say CC BY-SA 4.0. There is no LICENSE file and no separate license for the code, and bundled data from MathDial and Bridge keeps those datasets' terms.

access_note: Running it needs a local model server or an OpenAI-compatible API key.
cite: Macina, J., Daheim, N., Hakimi, I., Kapur, M., Gurevych, I., & Sachan, M. (2025). MathTutorBench: A Benchmark for Measuring Open-ended Pedagogical Capabilities of LLM Tutors. EMNLP 2025. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.11

fits.how: Its teaching tasks and reward model could rate replies in agent tests, once its license is confirmed.
